name: ecosys-autonomous-orchestration
description: Resume and execute autonomous Ottawa cycles with one model; use for pickup, decisions, recovery and cycle closure.

name: ecosys-build-reproducibility
description: Verify exact Zig/legacy builds, packaging and restart reproducibility; use for build drift and release checks.

name: ecosys-conservation-audit
description: Independently verify local/global mass and energy budgets; use for balance failures and physical acceptance.

name: ecosys-divergence-diagnosis
description: Find the earliest causal legacy/Zig divergence; use for failed hours, unexplained outputs and repeated experiments.

name: ecosys-feature-attribution
description: Causally validate intentional physical/numerical changes; use when attributing differences to approved features.

name: ecosys-fortran-zig-traceability
description: Audit complete bidirectional statement/equation/control-flow provenance; use for source gaps and translation defects.

name: ecosys-nonlinear-solver-audit
description: Audit Newton/Anderson residuals, bounds and transactional acceptance; use for stiff, oscillatory or rejected hours.

name: ecosys-output-comparison
description: Compare all raw legacy/Zig production outputs with verified units and time support; use for parity and release.

name: ecosys-performance-engineering
description: Measure build/runtime/memory and optimize equivalent accepted work; use for diagnosed expensive paths.

name: ecosys-process-science-parity
description: Audit process equations and coupled legacy semantics; use for scientific defects across water, heat, biology and chemistry.

name: ecosys-release-orchestrator
description: Choose the critical path to complete Ottawa qualification; use for mission planning and readiness decisions.

name: ecosys-release-verification
description: Decide final Ottawa readiness from one integrated evidence set; use only after source/test/campaign evidence exists.

name: ecosys-repository-baseline
description: Establish source/input/toolchain identity and a usable legacy oracle; use before parity or when provenance is stale.

name: ecosys-source-navigation
description: Locate legacy statements, COMMON state and matched-state oracle inputs using f77index tools.

name: ecosys-state-io-bindings
description: Trace state ownership, process coupling, parser defaults and output semantics; use for stale/zero/wrong fields.

name: ecosys-validation-tests
description: Choose discriminating regression, coupling and event checks; use after fixes and before integration.

name: ecosys-zig-safety-design
description: Review Zig ownership, error handling and ReleaseFast safety; use for refactors and production hardening.
